changelog: Performance: DNS lookups no longer serialize concurrent connections; cache entries expire after 5 minutes
Performance: direct connections dial the already-resolved IP, so first connections to a new host no longer take seconds
Connections: TUN direct connections now appear in the connections page with geo info, latency and traffic stats
TUN: TUN settings apply immediately on change - no Save button and no app restart needed
TUN: route commands no longer flash console windows on TUN toggle or diagnostics
Security: rate-limit tables swept periodically, logs rotate at 10 MB, log viewer reads only the tail, fake-ip pool prefixes validated
